Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.core

Class AbstractRulesEngine<O>

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.core.AbstractRulesEngine<O>
Type Parameters:
O - The output object to instantiate
All Implemented Interfaces:
RulesEngine<O>
Direct Known Subclasses:
StatefulRulesEngine, StatelessRulesEngine
public abstract class AbstractRulesEngine<O> extends Object implements RulesEngine<O>
The AbstractRulesEngine is an abstract implementation of the RulesEngine interface. The RulesEngine fires the action expression from a list of Rule objects when their conditions evaluate to true.

MVEL optimizer: the engine leaves MVEL's global optimizer setting alone. Concurrent run() calls never share a compiled expression, because MVEL replaces the accessors cached in one without synchronization when a fact's runtime class changes, so they are safe with any optimizer, including MVEL's default JIT optimizer.

    • withCompiledRules

      protected <T> T withCompiledRules(Function<List<io.github.brantunger.unruly.core.CompiledRule>,T> run)
      Calls run with a compiled copy of the rules that no concurrent run is using, and keeps the copy for later runs once run returns or throws. MVEL's compiled expressions aren't safe to share between threads when a fact name is bound to different kinds of objects; see RuleSet.

      A missing call to setRuleList(List) (e.g. a forgotten @PostConstruct) used to make every run return null, indistinguishable from "no rule matched", so it is reported instead.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The type run returns
      Parameters:
      run - The body of a run, given the compiled rules in priority order, possibly none
      Returns:
      What run returns
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if setRuleList(List) has not been called

    • setRuleList

      public void setRuleList(List<Rule> ruleList)
      Set the list of rules used for processing in the Rules Engine. Rules are sorted by priority in descending order (highest priority first). Rules with a null priority are treated as lowest priority. Rules with equal priority keep their relative order from ruleList.

      Note: Any package imports configured via addImport(String) or addImports(Set) must be set before calling this method, as rules are compiled with the imports registered at the time of this call.

      Every condition and action is compiled in isolation. Variables, their types and inline import statements in one expression don't affect any other rule, in this list or a later one.

      Classes in imported packages are looked up with the context class loader of the thread that calls this method. run() checks fact names against the same class loader, whichever thread it runs on.

      Specified by:
      setRuleList in interface RulesEngine<O>
      Parameters:
      ruleList - The List of Rule objects to compile.
      Throws:
      RuleCompilationException - if a rule fails to compile, has a null or blank condition or action, has a condition that contains an assignment, shares its name with another rule, or if the list contains a null rule
      NullPointerException - if ruleList itself is null

    • addImports

      public RulesEngine<O> addImports(Set<String> packages)
      Adds imports that rules are compiled with, so rule expressions can refer to classes by their simple names. Each string is a fully qualified package name ("java.util") or class name ("java.time.LocalDate", or "java.util.Map.Entry" for a nested class).

      Imports are accumulated across multiple calls. This method must be called before setRuleList(List) for the imports to take effect.

      Specified by:
      addImports in interface RulesEngine<O>
      Parameters:
      packages - A set of packages or classes to import
      Returns:
      A reference to this RulesEngine
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a string is neither a loadable class nor a valid package name; nothing is imported
      NullPointerException - if packages or any element is null

    • unwrapFacts

      protected Map<String,Object> unwrapFacts(FactStore<Object> facts)
      Unwraps the FactStore into a Map of values to be used as context variables in MVEL evaluation. This should be called once per engine run to avoid expensive allocations.
      Parameters:
      facts - The key/value fact store
      Returns:
      A map of variable names to their values
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a fact is named output, which actions reserve for the output object, or has a name rules can't refer to: one that isn't a Java identifier, a reserved MVEL word, or a class name MVEL resolves instead of the fact

      Execute a single CompiledRule object's action field against the input data
      Parameters:

    • createOutput

      protected O createOutput(Supplier<O> outputFactory)
      Creates a fresh output object from the engine's factory. Without this, a factory that throws escaped run() unwrapped, and one that returned null surfaced later as an action failure blamed on whichever rule ran first.
      Parameters:
      outputFactory - The factory supplied to the engine's constructor
      Returns:
      The new output object, never null
      Throws:
      RuleExecutionException - if the factory throws or returns null. An Error other than StackOverflowError or AssertionError is rethrown unchanged.
